description: 黑方驱赶白王，h兵升变关键时刻

intro.popup_en: Black moves first. White's connected pawns are close to promotion, so Black must use precise checks to drive the white king away.
intro.popup: 黑方先走白方双兵即将升变，黑方必须精确驱赶白王来阻止。

outro.popup_en: White is winning. The f-pawn advances, and promotion is decisive.
outro.popup: 白方胜势白方成功推进f兵，升变局势已定。

moves.popup_en: The black rook checks from behind, trying to drive the white king away from the pawns.
moves.popup: 黑车将军！黑方从后方将军，试图驱赶白王远离兵区。

moves.popup_en: The white rook blocks the check and stabilizes the position.
moves.popup: 白车挡住将军，稳住阵脚。

moves.popup_en: The black rook retreats and waits for another opportunity.
The f-pawn advances. Black must respond.
moves.popup: f兵向前！白方抓住机会推进，黑方必须应对。

moves.popup_en: The white king captures the h-pawn and consolidates the position.
The black rook checks from the h-file and continues harassing the white king.
moves.popup: 黑车从h线将军，继续骚扰白王。

moves.popup_en: The white king evades the check and approaches the center.
moves.popup: 白王躲避将军，向中心靠近。

moves.popup_en: The black king approaches the pawn to try to stop promotion.
moves.popup: 黑王靠近兵，试图阻止升变。

moves.popup_en: The white rook swings to the g-file and directly supports the f-pawn, creating a decisive attack.
moves.popup: 白车转移到g线！直接支援f兵，形成决定性攻势。

moves.popup_en: The pawn reaches f7, one step from promotion. Black cannot stop it.
moves.popup: 兵推到f7！升变只差一步，黑方无法阻止。
